scientific_context: Imine reductases convert imines to amines and are used in pharmaceutical production.
source_partition: Official train and validation variants with zero, one, or two mutations.
deployment_partition: Official test variants with more than two mutations.
public_mutation_range: The complete dataset includes variants with up to 15 mutations.
optimization_endpoint: Best-so-far activity AUC under three initial target observations and twelve additional reveals.
evidence_constraint: Official test activities are unavailable to the planner, calibration gate, and skill selector.
source: Didi et al., FLIP2, ICML 2026 Spotlight; official FLIP2 website and Zenodo record 18433203.
